featured_reviews.name: Alekhya G

A special thanks to Hvovi Ma’am, Umang Ma’am, and Asmita Ma’am for their constant guidance and support. From university shortlisting and application strategy to reviewing multiple versions of my Statement of Purpose, essays, resume, and other application materials, they were always available with detailed feedback and valuable suggestions.

The visa preparation process was particularly helpful. The mock interviews and extensive question bank gave me the confidence to approach my visa interview well prepared. The team also carefully reviewed my documents and helped me make informed decisions when choosing between my admits.

What stood out the most was that their support continued even after admissions. They assisted me with accommodation-related decisions and helped make the transition process much smoother.

I applied to 10 universities in the United States and received admits from 9. I highly recommend goGenius to anyone looking for knowledgeable mentors who are genuinely invested in their students’ success.
